peer_identity.arc_label: Recurring Shabda-Oud witches / whore-priestesses as an order-member group across eras
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Group-role card for ordinary Shabda-Oud witches/priestesses/reverend mothers; encode general traits and group facts, not a single individual.
peer_identity.rationale: Project lore rule: one, two, three, four, or more whore-priestesses/witches are recurring Shabda-Oud order members, not distinct peer personas.

important_actions: Examined Aghnar in the Hall of Arms
Attacked Aghnar and Honorata; multiple killed
Invoked the Shabda-Oud's psychic power offensively against Honorata
relationships: {'Shabda-Oud': 'religious-political arm of the organization', 'Aghnar': 'they examine him; he ambushes and kills multiple of them using their own airborne quality against them', 'Honorata': 'one attacks Honorata with Shabda-Oud psychic power; Honorata counterattacks'}
voice_notes: The older priestess is calculating and uses deliberate speech as a strategic weapon (issuing threats over monitored channels)
Invoke 'Jejoh the Pure' in prayer or blessing
witnessed_facts: Boarded a Harana-class robo-transporter to reach Okhar; its catayborg controller was sedated with pentalina for two hours
Deliberately spoke the vessel's destructive capabilities aloud to warn any eavesdroppers not to betray them to the Metabaron
Were received ceremonially at the Castaka fortress as prophets of Jejoh
Conducted the Hall of Arms examination: detected alpha-mode brain state; found no killer programming in Aghnar; permitted him to approach
Coerced Aghnar into a humiliating inspection of his sex organs
Were attacked by Aghnar using blade prosthetics after he was provoked
Multiple were killed by Aghnar who exploited their epyphite-infused prostheses' airborne quality
One launched a psychic attack against Honorata invoking the Shabda-Oud's mental power

important_actions: Sent three pilots to abduct Princess Oda for her genetics (vol 7 ic1)
Subjected Oda to a forced reproductive ritual at their lair, invoking Jejoh and targeting the birth of Sama-Wajd (vol 7 p16, p17)
Ordered cetacyborg forces deployed upon discovering the spy (vol 7 p18)
The Elders launched a collective psychic assault on Aghnar using their remaining independent power (vol 7 p24, p25)
Were catastrophically weakened and largely destroyed after Jejoh was eliminated (vol 7 p23)
knowledge_boundaries: Only one witch survives at the volume's end; knowledge of cetacyborg weaknesses is held by that survivor alone (vol 7 p27)
relationships: character: Oda; type: target / captive; notes: Abducted Oda specifically for her genetics; subjected her to a forced reproductive ritual (vol 7 p15–p17)
character: Jejoh; type: deity / power source; notes: Jejoh's brainwaves fuel all Shabda-Oud psychic power; loss of Jejoh destroys them as a fighting force (vol 7 p23)
character: Sama-Wajd; type: prophesied goal — to be produced; notes: Their entire mission across twelve generations is to create the genetic conditions for Sama-Wajd's birth
character: Aghnar; type: enemy / infiltrator / destroyer; notes: Aghnar infiltrated the lair disguised as a priestess, destroyed Jejoh, and broke their power
traits: All-female religious and political faction pursuing a twelve-generation breeding plan to produce Sama-Wajd
Hierarchical structure: common soldiers, reverend mothers, eldest of elders
Psychic powers entirely dependent on Jejoh's brainwaves; catastrophically weakened without him
The Elders retain independent psychic power not reliant on Jejoh, though described as limited reserves
Maintain a lair carved from an ice asteroid in deep space, entry controlled by a delta-psychic force-switch
Use multi-layer biological, brainwave, and infra-conscious identity verification at their lair's entry
Create and deploy cetacyborg creatures as military assets
Capable of detecting infiltrators via probe systems that flag anomalous brainwave or genetic signatures
voice_notes: Eldest elder to Oda: 'Your womb will generate the one we have awaited for twelve generations' (vol 7 p15)
Opening ritual invocation: 'Sama-Wajd — chosen hermaphrodite — will dethrone Janus-Jana and grant absolute power' (vol 7 p16)
Elders to Aghnar: 'We have power independent of Jejoh — we will spend our last energy to exterminate the traitor' (vol 7 p24)
witnessed_facts: Discovered a spy was among them mid-ritual and immediately escalated their response (vol 7 p18)

appearances: description: Represented by witches and associated figures; not shown as a single character but as a collective antagonist faction; source_refs: ['206_The_Metabarons_8_ic1', '212_The_Metabarons_8_p07', '216_The_Metabarons_8_p11']
traits: Associated with heart-bombs implanted in targets
Target of Aghnar's multigenerational revenge campaign

appearances: description: Cybernetically integrated women operating inside a biomechanical octocyborg; at least one commands attendants who address her as 'Mother.'; source_refs: ['428_The_Metabarons_17_p01']
description: Pale, luminous priestess-like women shown advancing inside the fortress interior.; source_refs: ['429_The_Metabarons_17_p02']
important_actions: action: Traveled covertly to Kgen-Kgen in an octocyborg with invisibility shield and emptied spirits; ordered the Kantylopter awakened.; source_refs: ['428_The_Metabarons_17_p01']
action: Breached Kgen-Kgen via orbital beam and killed guards with combined mental force.; source_refs: ['429_The_Metabarons_17_p02']
action: Used shadow rods and psycho-essence to free Zombra from her planetary-scale prison.; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03']
action: Unleashed the Zombra swarm in the Gardens of Flos while Aghora was in labor.; source_refs: ['435_The_Metabarons_17_p08-p09']
action: Led or participated in the psychic assault against the Empress's court at the Golden Planet.; source_refs: ['442_The_Metabarons_17_p16']
knowledge_boundaries: Knew Aghora was nine months pregnant and exploited this tactical window.
Their larger plan for galactic domination beyond the immediate events is not detailed.
relationships: character: Zombra; nature: Freed her from Kgen-Kgen; plan to use her as instrument of galactic domination; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03']
character: The Metabaron; nature: Adversary who previously wiped out nearly their entire clan, leaving only four survivors; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03']
character: Aghora; nature: Target; orchestrated the Zombra swarm ambush against her during labor; source_refs: ['435_The_Metabarons_17_p08-p09']
traits: Act collectively rather than individually, pooling psychic force for lethal mental attacks
Cautious against mental probing: emptied their spirits before approaching Kgen-Kgen
Covert operatives capable of bypassing detection systems
Motivated by survival, revenge on the Metabaron, and plans for galactic domination
Only four survive at the time of volume 17
voice_notes: At least one is addressed as 'Mother' by attendant servitors.
Stated explicit goal: 'seize control and rule the galaxy.'
witnessed_facts: fact: Activated an invisibility shield and emptied their spirits to evade mental probes during approach to Kgen-Kgen.; source_refs: ['428_The_Metabarons_17_p01']
fact: Bypassed Kgen-Kgen's orbital defenses via a directed beam from the octocyborg; killed guards with combined psychic force.; source_refs: ['429_The_Metabarons_17_p02']
fact: Only four of the clan survived after the Metabaron's earlier assault.; source_refs: ['430_The_Metabarons_17_p03']
